title: policy
description: An insurance contract between an insurer and a policyholder, identified by a policy number that persists across renewals. For group business the master contract and each certificate are policies linked by master_policy_id.

oneOf.description: Group master contract issued to an employer, association or trust
Certificate or member-level contract under a group master

master_policy_id.description: Group master contract for a certificate.

oneOf.description: Bound or applied for, not yet in force
Terminated for non-payment after grace period (life/health)
Terminated by death of the insured
Converted or exchanged to another policy

governing_jurisdiction_code.description: State whose law and filings govern the contract (issue state).

original_inception_date.description: First effective date of continuous coverage; issue date for life and annuity.

replaces_policy_id.description: Prior policy this one rewrote, converted from or replaced (including 1035 exchanges).

is_assumed_business.description: True for policies acquired through assumption or book transfer.
